page_title: LAZ 0-2 ATA | Lazio v Atalanta 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Boulaye Dia (Lazio) inside the box.
90+3' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
90+1' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
89' CHANCE! Petar Ratkov (Lazio) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
89' The ball goes out for a corner. Lazio can continue in their attacking effort.
89' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
88' The substitution has been made. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) has replaced Gustav Isaksen.
87' Petar Ratkov (Lazio) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
84' Lazio have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
83' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Davide Zappacosta is replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
81' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Kenneth Taylor can be given a rest.
78' Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
76' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) unloads a good strike from the free kick just outside the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is stopped by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a glorious save!
74' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lazio.
71' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Luca Sacchi saw the whole situation. Lazio earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicola Zalewski departs the field of play to be replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
68' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
67' Here is a change. Tijjani Noslin is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Petar Ratkov (Lazio).
67' Substitution. Danilo Cataldi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio).
67' Daniel Maldini (Lazio) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
65' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 9:9.
63' Lazio take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' 0 - 2 Goal! Lorenzo Bernasconi slips it to Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 0:2.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
57' A pass from Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
56' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.

54' A rebound falls to Adam Marusic (Lazio) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
54' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Marco Carnesecchi, who pulls off a stunning save!
53' Lazio take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
50' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.

49' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lazio players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the Atalanta players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
46' The second half gets underway.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Raffaele Palladino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Lazar Samardzic. He is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Giorgio Scalvini is replaced by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mario Gila (Lazio) comes off for Patric.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' He should have scored! Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Ivan Provedel makes an easy save.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ederson (Atalanta) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Ivan Provedel no chance!
40' Ederson (Atalanta) is going to take the penalty!
39' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Atalanta.

39' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Looks like Mario Gila (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
35' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
33' Handball by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).

31' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
28' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

28' What a sweet touch by Kenneth Taylor (Lazio) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
25' Substitution. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) on for Honest Ahanor.
24' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lazio.
21' The corner finds Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
21' Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
18' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

17' What a great touch by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
16' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Marco Carnesecchi easily deals with the threat.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

11' The game has begun to heat up. Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle. It's a free kick to Lazio, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
10' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
8' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' The referee blows his whistle after Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
2' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
